summary: The build completes, but release remains blocked by a hard-coded backend credential, backend contract drift, demo fallbacks, and contact-path resilience issues.
findings: benson-genkit-backend/functions/src/genkit-config.ts contains a live hard-coded Google AI API key.
src/lib/genkit.ts still maps Firebase callable names with an Endpoint suffix that does not match deployed exports.
src/app/api/estimator/route.ts still returns demo-mode data and forwards a payload shape that does not match the backend flow contract.
src/lib/ratelimit.ts instantiates Upstash with dummy credentials when env vars are unset.
